sections: 8.3-8.5 source coordinate systems and path construction/painting
14.8 table structure and span attributes; 14.9.4 ActualText replacement

decisions: Keep literal source-grid/alignment inference separate from semantic structure or rendered rule visibility
Retain page/character/operator/rule provenance and reject partial ActualText/nonrectangular merges/unsupported cell text directions
Declare heuristic geometric scores without presenting them as calibrated semantic probability or qualification metrics
Require explicit culture for decimal interpretation; retain original text and unparsed strings
Require explicit merged-cell CSV policy, header omission and formula-prefix escaping; retain original page/header tables and sequence decisions
Use UTF-8 quoted CRLF CSV and versioned JSON with typed values/spans/provenance; independent standard parsers check actual original outputs
limitations: Primary CSV/JSON RFC document downloads were denied with HTTP403 on the configured network path. Independent standard-library parsing and small fixtures do not establish complete interchange conformance.
Complete semantic/visibility/inference/culture/corpus profiles and production qualification remain mandatory.
